class.name: NetwPredictEvidence
class.brief_description: A write-only staging area for one acknowledgement's evidence fingerprints, filled once and handed to an admit call.
class.description: Holds no accessors of its own: [method fill] is the entire public surface, and the row it fills is read only by whichever call consumes it, such as [method NetwPredictionEngine.admit_ack]. A caller decoding an [NetwPredictAckFrame] record fills one of these per record and passes it along rather than threading the same fourteen fingerprints through every admit call as loose arguments.

method.name: fill
method.description: Stages one evidence row. [param pre_pose_fp], [param pre_momentum_fp], and [param pre_controller_fp] are the pre-state family fingerprints; the matching [code]post_*[/code] parameters are their post-state counterparts. [param complete] marks whether every field this row's caller expected evidence for actually arrived, which decides whether a partial row is trusted or refused. Calling this again overwrites the previous fill entirely.
